newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin expected to leave sanatorium, meets PM.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin expected to leave sanatorium, meets PM.

text.p: Russia's Boris Yeltsin was likely to move from the Barvikha sanatorium, where he has been recovering from major heart surgery, to a presidential residence in the same compound on Wednesday, Itar-Tass news agency said.

Russian news agencies also said Yeltsin met Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin in the sanatorium earlier in the day to discuss a European security summit, just ended in Lisbon, and the 1997 budget plan, due to be considered by the country's Communist-dominated parliament on Friday.
They gave no details of the discussion.

Chernomyrdin represented Russia at the Lisbon summit and found himself diplomatically isolated when he voiced strong opposition to NATO's plans to expand eastwards and defended controversial allies Belarus and rump Yugoslavia.
